session.support_notes: I met with the tenant for their move-in support session and welcomed them into the supported accommodation. We discussed the house rules, fire safety and how to report repairs.
session.support_note_summary: This session covered the tenant's move-in induction, including house rules, fire safety procedures and how to report repairs, ensuring the tenant understood their responsibilities from day one.
any_actions_to_be_completed_by_service_u: Follow the house rules and respect other tenants.
Report repairs or safety concerns promptly.
any_action_to_be_taken_by_support_worker: Check that the tenant has settled safely.
Prepare GP registration support for the next session.

sessions.evidence_picture_description: A printable A4 move-in checklist titled 'Move-In Induction Checklist' with tick boxes for house rules, fire exits, key safety and a notes area at the bottom.

session.support_notes: I met with the tenant for a one-hour support session focused on registering with a GP. We gathered the information needed for registration and discussed nearby surgeries.
session.support_note_summary: This session focused on supporting the tenant to gather the details required for GP registration and identify a suitable local surgery to register with.
any_actions_to_be_completed_by_service_u: Complete and submit the registration form.
any_action_to_be_taken_by_support_worker: Check whether the GP registration has been submitted.

sessions.evidence_picture_description: A printable A4 GP registration tracker titled 'GP Registration Tracker' with a table for surgery name, date contacted, registration status and a notes area.
